title: Add clean-environment (no native toolchain) release artifact smoke test
description: ADR 0016 (docs/adr/0016-native-dependency-install-policy-by-environment.md) requires proving that unpacked release artifacts run without a native build toolchain present, not just with a restricted PATH on a toolchain-equipped GitHub-hosted runner. Add a release.yml job that runs the unpacked launcher (bin/eshyra, no-config exit-1 path) inside an environment that genuinely lacks a C/C++ toolchain (e.g. a minimal Linux container image without build-essential/python3), fed a pre-built artifact from the existing build job. Scope initial coverage to Linux; Windows/macOS GitHub-hosted runners ship toolchains by default and cannot easily be made toolchain-free without self-hosted runners, per ADR 0016.
acceptance_criteria: A release.yml job runs the bundled CLI launcher against a genuinely toolchain-free Linux environment and asserts the same no-config behavior validate-release-artifact.mjs already checks (exit 1, expected guidance output). The job is gated the same way as other release-path checks (runs on PR when release inputs change, and on tag pushes). Documented in docs/cli-distribution.md or the ADR itself once implemented.
close_reason: Merged as PR #379 (merge commit 8db918d). clean-env-smoke.sh + the clean-env-smoke release job run the linux-x64 artifact's bundled launcher inside a toolchain-free debian:bookworm-slim container (self-checks gcc/make/python3/node absent), asserting exit 1 + setup guidance; gates tag publication. Confirmed passing in real CI. ADR 0016 layer-3 clean-env requirement now satisfied.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Implemented in PR #379. scripts/release/clean-env-smoke.sh + the clean-env-smoke release.yml job run the linux-x64 artifact's bundled launcher inside a debian:bookworm-slim container that genuinely lacks gcc/cc/make/cmake/python/python3/node/npm/node-gyp (self-checked), with a scrubbed no-config env, asserting exit 1 + setup guidance. Gates the tag-release job. Linux-only (bundled Node is glibc; Win/mac runners ship toolchains).

Confirmed in real CI: the clean-env-smoke job passed on the Release workflow for PR #379 — container self-check "confirmed: no gcc/... on PATH", launcher ran on its own runtime, exit 1 with guidance, PASS. All 34 PR checks green (1 skipped = tag-gated release-attach). Docs (ADR 0016 section, cli-distribution.md) marked implemented; releaseInstallerPolicy.test.ts guards added.
